Name: Munny
Description: Set the money stored in the current save.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Direct DWORD write at Save+9280; native debug range 0..999999.

Name: Shared EXP
Description: Current shared experience total. Use Add EXP to process native level-up rewards.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Shared EXP at Save+14048; native upper bound 9999999.

Name: Add EXP
Description: Add experience through the game's level-up handler, including reward abilities and level notifications.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Adds positive EXP, caps total and processes levels 1..99 for party character slots.
Applies level rewards and can enqueue the level-99 achievement.

Name: Set item stock
Description: Set bag stock for a consumable, boost, equipment item, synthesis material or recipe. Equipped copies are separate.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Native give-one with destination 100 changes stock and acquisition bits.
Native stock removal clamps at zero; stock is Save+13696[item.slot].

Name: Grant unique item
Description: Grant a summon charm, map or report with a validated unique ownership bit. Forms are excluded until their initialization path is supported.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Unique ownership is Save+14016, selected by item.slot. Uses the game's acquisition handler.

Name: Add ability
Description: Add an ability only if it is absent. The character has 80 entries. Active characters must be in normal form; inactive changes apply when loaded.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Character ability array starts at +84 with 80 ushort entries.
Bit 0x8000 activates an ability; ID is masked with 0x7FFF.

Name: Enable or disable ability
Description: Change the enabled bit for every owned copy of this ability. This does not enforce the menu's AP budget.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Rebuild consumes enabled signed-negative ushort ability entries.
Syncs live HP/MP before rebuilding stats and abilities from the save.

Name: Remove one ability copy
Description: Remove the first owned copy of this ability. Other copies keep their state.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Zero ID marks a free ability entry; iteration/rebuild covers all 80 entries.

Name: Character to inspect
Description: Choose the save character shown by the level, weapon and ability-count readings.

Evidence.Finding: 13 character save entries, stride276; runtime IDs14 and15 alias slots1 and6.

Name: Selected character level
Description: Current stored level. Decreasing it directly would leave level rewards and other progress inconsistent.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Character+15 is the level byte; advancement applies reward records.

Name: Selected weapon ID
Description: Stored primary weapon ID for the selected character. See the item catalog for its name.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Reads weapon WORDs at character+0/+2 and applies equipment properties.

Name: Occupied ability entries
Description: Number of nonempty ability entries for the selected character, including disabled copies.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: 80 ushort entries with ID mask0x7FFF.

Name: Item ID to inspect
Description: Choose an item ID for the ownership reading. The named item controls also update this selection.

Evidence.Finding: Scans the runtime item table for its ushort ID.

Name: Selected item stock / ownership
Description: Bag quantity for a count item, or 0/1 ownership for a unique item. Character abilities use their own list.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Distinguishes unique bits, ability entries and stock counts.

Name: Restock basic consumables
Description: Set stock for Potion, Hi-Potion, Ether, Elixir, Mega-Potion, Mega-Ether and Megalixir after validating all seven entries.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Local base asset names and count-based type0 records.
Uses the same validated native stock handlers as individual edits.

Name: Total stored item units
Description: Sum of the 320 bag quantity bytes. Unique unlocks and equipped copies are not included.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Count-based inventory uses Save+13696 plus item slot; base layout reserves320bytes.

Name: Equip armor
Description: Move owned bag stock into an unlocked character slot. Enter item ID 0 to unequip. Active characters must be in normal form; the old item returns to the bag.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Character armor at +20/accessories at +36; unlocked capacities+16/+17. Stats/equipment abilities rebuilt from item and equipment-stat tables.
Native party removal returns armor/accessories to bag, then clears equipped entries; trainer likewise preserves total owned copies.

Name: Equip accessory
Description: Move owned bag stock into an unlocked character slot. Enter item ID 0 to unequip. Active characters must be in normal form; the old item returns to the bag.
RestoreBehavior: One-time changes remain in the in-memory save and may be saved by the game. Closing the trainer does not undo them.

Evidence.Finding: Character armor at +20/accessories at +36; unlocked capacities+16/+17. Stats/equipment abilities rebuilt from item and equipment-stat tables.
Native party removal returns armor/accessories to bag, then clears equipped entries; trainer likewise preserves total owned copies.
